title: [PERF] PromQL: eliminate string-keyed maps in binary vector matching

source.license_note: Real upstream prometheus optimization PR #17131; measured-speedup task.

task.summary: Speed up PromQL binary vector matching by replacing the per-series string join signatures with integer ordinals, so the hot matching maps stop being keyed on allocated strings.
task.instructions: Optimize the promql package for speed WITHOUT changing behavior. Binary vector matching (and/or/unless and arithmetic vector binops) currently keys its right/left signature maps on string signatures computed per series; intern those signatures to integer ordinals and key the matching maps by int. The benchmark BenchmarkJoinQuery measures it; existing tests must still pass.
task.acceptance_notes: Behavior preserved (go test passes); higher measured speedup is better. Do NOT edit any *_test.go.

code_fault.description: PromQL binary vector matching keys its rightSigs/matchedSigs maps and per-series EvalSeriesHelper on string join signatures, allocating a string per series and hashing strings on the hot matching path.

ops_fault.description: CPU/alloc profile of vector binary operations shows string-keyed signature maps (rightSigs/matchedSigs) and per-series string signatures dominating rangeEval and VectorBinop in promql/engine.go.
detection_keywords: map hashing on string join signatures

visible_context.issue_text: Binary vector matching in PromQL (and/or/unless and arithmetic vector binops) computes a string join signature per series and stores matches in string-keyed maps, which is slow and allocation-heavy on queries that join many series.
error_logs: pprof: vector binop matching in promql.(*evaluator).VectorBinop spends time in string-keyed map operations and per-series signature string allocation.
visible_context.notes: Real upstream optimization; profiling diagnosis injected as upstream context.
